The cluster measures approximately 2 x 1.25 x 1 inches and features multiple well-formed points with a sparkling druse surface. The crystal displays subtle light pink to lavender hues on a white to beige quartz matrix. One side of this specimen has been cut to reveal the internal development of the crystal. The cluster includes both translucent and slightly opaque areas with minor natural inclusions and matrix contact at the base. The specimen is raw and unpolished, suitable for collectors, display, or metaphysical use.
